validation: Four contact scheduling tests: real overlap on independent contacts, sequential shared-dynamic fallback, exact positions and velocities across worker counts, heavy/light and enable changes. Debug tests and standalone Release passed.

Six consumer soft contact tests passed in Debug and standalone Release: inertia, momentum, friction torque, filters, thin-wall CCD, conservative sweeps and worker equivalence.
All eleven module fixtures passed floor and bead assertions for 480 ticks each.
Eight loaded ramp approaches passed for 1200 ticks each.
Direction controls passed both senses, pitch orientations, final-drive ratios and alternating physical reaction.
Scene checks passed input, reset, tire meshes, HUD, travel camera and rollover horizon.
Compiler zig build check and zig build test passed; 311 native language cases passed in 122 files.
measurement_limits: No builds, tests or profiler ran during the retained timed comparisons. OS background activity, temperature and CPU scheduling are not controlled.

Physical runs use balanced before/after/after/before order. The first 120 ticks of each run are excluded from mean computation. All four physical checkpoints match exactly in position, speed and bead error. The committed harness adds floor/bead validation after the timed step; timed binaries precede that assertion addition.

Graphical runs use the same 1280x800 scene, active engine sound and twelve-second brake-held small-roller scenario. Only intervals after two seconds with focused=true and focus_changed=false are used for foreground summaries.

Graphical baseline is non-stationary: first/last medians96.20/47.76FPS. Candidate medians119.74/105.19FPS; minima92.55/92.60FPS. These are local observations, not a general FPS speedup or a guaranteed floor.
Fixed-step headroom and catch-up amplify FPS changes relative to fixed-work physics cost.
Pure Silex scheduling applies across targets; correctness and performance measured here only on macOS ARM64. No x64 or other OS performance claim.
Rejected endpoint box filtering and earlier small geometry-cache experiments are excluded; retained solver equations and settings are unchanged.
